step1.title: 1-qadam: Sinab ko'ring
step1.description: O'zgarishlarni ko'rish uchun {{file}} ni tahrirlang. Ishlab chiquvchi vositalarini ochish uchun {{shortcut}} tugmasini bosing.

step2.title: 2-qadam: O'rganing
step2.description: Ushbu boshlang'ich ilovada nima borligini bilish uchun O'rganish varaqasini bosing.

step3.title: 3-qadam: Yangi boshlang
step3.description: Tayyor bo'lganingizda, yangi {{directory}} katalogini olish uchun {{command}} ni ishga tushiring. Joriy {{directory}} {{exampleDirectory}} ga ko'chiriladi.
